title: Equal but Inequitable: Who Benefits from Gender-Neutral Tenure Clock Stopping Policies?
notes: MISMATCH vs accessible version: working paper says men +19 pp / women -22 pp; SOURCES.md '+17 / -19' presumably the published AER estimates, which could not be verified (AER PDF 403; abstract gives no numbers). IZA DP p.3 and Table 3: gender-neutral clock stopping raises men's probability of tenure at first job by 19 pp (0.194) and lowers women's by 22 pp (0.194-0.419 = -0.224).
